facts.fact: Per eMarketer research cited by AdWave, 46% of American adults rank television as the most trustworthy advertising channel.
facts.quote: Nearly half of American adults (46%) rank television as the most trustworthy advertising channel, while only 19% say the same about social media according to eMarketer research.

facts.fact: Per eMarketer research cited by AdWave, 19% of American adults say social media ads are the most trustworthy advertising channel.
facts.quote: while only 19% say the same about social media according to eMarketer research.

facts.fact: Per Marketing Sherpa as cited by AdWave, 80% of consumers trust TV ads to inform purchase decisions.
facts.quote: 80% of consumers trust TV ads to inform purchase decisions vs. 61% for search engine ads and 25% for online pop-ups

facts.fact: Per Statista as cited by AdWave, 46% of Generation Z trusts TV ads.
facts.quote: 46% of Generation Z trusts TV ads, while 61% don't find social media ads trustworthy

facts.fact: Per a Medium article cited by AdWave, 88% of consumer buying decisions are influenced by trust.
facts.quote: 88% of consumer buying decisions are influenced by trust

facts.fact: Per Blacksmith Agency as cited by AdWave, 81% of consumers need to trust a brand before considering buying from it.
facts.quote: 81% of consumers need to trust a brand before considering buying from it

facts.fact: Per WordStream as cited by AdWave, 73% of consumers dislike pop-up ads.
facts.quote: 73% of consumers dislike pop-up ads, indicating intrusive digital formats actively erode trust

facts.fact: Per Statista as cited by AdWave, 55% of US adults report finding advertising on linear TV to be effective.
facts.quote: 55% of US adults report finding advertising on linear TV to be effective

facts.fact: AdWave states that print advertising ties TV at 46% for trust among consumers.
facts.quote: The print advertising tie at 46% alongside TV reflects the broader pattern of traditional media outperforming digital for trust.
